data.long_meaning: Pragati is a name of great significance in Hindu and Sanskrit tradition. It symbolizes the journey of life, the progress and development of one's soul, and the evolution towards spiritual growth and enlightenment. The name Pragati carries the meaning “Progress, development, evolution” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Pragati usually hope their child will grow to embody progress, development, evolution and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pragati total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
